A [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] studied with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its formative in the centuries following the [[Force Wars]] and the abandonment of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] circa [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. Stationed at a camp with several other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Nosaurian sat around a campfire with fellow apprentices [[Cope Shykrill]], a [[Unidentified Human apprentice|Human]], and a [[Unidentified Fian apprentice|Fian]]. While listening to a shadow play by Shykrill, the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] apprentice called upon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to send him into a rage and slaughter the Fian and the Human. He injured Shykrill as part of the Selonian's attempt to cast suspicion onto the Nosaurian, who slit his own throat after exclaiming that the shadows were in his head. While Shykrill hoped to be free of blame, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Sar Agorn]] and [[Nuck Lyu]] saw through the ruse and killed the dark sider.<ref name="JVS" />
